message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to retrieve live weather data directly. However, you can easily get the hourly forecast for the next 10 days for the coordinates 37.8651 N, 119.5383 W by using the Open‑Meteo API yourself. Here’s a quick example of how you could do it with a simple HTTP request:

```bash
curl "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=37.8651&longitude=-119.5383&hourly=temperature_2m,windspeed_10m,precipitation&forecast_days=10&timezone=auto"
```

Or, if you prefer to use Python:

```python
import requests

url = "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast"
params = {
    "latitude": 37.8651,
    "longitude": -119.5383,
    "hourly": "temperature_2m,windspeed_10m,precipitation",
    "forecast_days": 10,
    "timezone": "auto",
}

response = requests.get(url, params=params)
data = response.json()
print(data)
```

This will give you a JSON object containing the hourly temperature (°C), wind speed (km/h), and precipitation (mm) for the next 10 days. Let me know if you’d like help interpreting the data or visualizing it!
